Class DcatMappingResult

java.lang.Object
org.odpi.openmetadata.frameworks.integration.dcat.mapping.DcatMappingResult
public class DcatMappingResult extends Object
DcatMappingResult describes what happened when a DCAT document was catalogued in open metadata.
